description_en: Disables one or more rules in an account group. After a rule is disabled, the resource in the rule is no longer evaluated. The compliance evaluation results before the rule is disabled are still displayed
description_zh: 停用指定账号组内的规则。停用规则后，不再对资源进行评估，仍显示停用前的合规评估结果
name: DeactiveAggregateConfigRules

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID. Separate multiple rule IDs with commas (,).

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。多个规则ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.name: config_rule_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of the account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance package.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a compliance package, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

schema.description_en: This operation does not return any operation-specific parameters

OperateRuleResult.description_en: The results of the operations that are performed to disable the specified rules

OperateRuleItemList.description_en: The operations that are performed to disable the rule

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code.

If the rule is disabled, no error code is returned.
If the rule fails to be disabled, an error code is returned. For more information about error codes, see Error codes (https://error-center.alibabacloud.com/status/product/Config)
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。

当您停用规则成功时，该参数为空。

当您停用规则失败时，该参数显示错误码。错误码详情，请参见<props="china">错误中心 (https://error-center.aliyun.com/status/product/Config)</props><props="intl">错误中心 (https://error-center.alibabacloud.com/status/product/Config)</props>

Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。
